veranderings.voor: Hy het ook as regsgeleerde mense gehelp.
veranderings.na: Hy het ook mense as regsgeleerde gehelp.
veranderings.rede: As written, 'regsgeleerde mense' can be misread as one noun phrase ('legally learned people'); moving 'mense' before 'as' removes the ambiguity and keeps the protected word.

veranderings.blok: Hy het gekies om te vergewe
veranderings.na: Hy het in die tronk Afrikaans geleer
veranderings.rede: The previous sentence ends on 'daarna' (after prison), so 'daar' no longer points clearly to the prison; naming it keeps the reference clear for a Grade 4 reader.

vlae.teks: In 1963 het 'n ander hofsaak teen hom begin.
vlae.rede: 'n ander hofsaak' presupposes an earlier court case, but the lesson mentions only the 1962 arrest, not a first trial; fixing it means either naming the earlier case or dropping 'ander', which is a content choice for the writer.
